column1: # Memorised spells. APPEND ONLY — one row per event; the current loadout is COMPUTED.
# Why this file exists: Frython's memorised spell lived only in narration for the
# whole of expeditions 1-4, and the clerics' remaining cures lived only in prose
# and in the DM's head. That is the same failure as the stale XP line and the
# stale equipment list in party_roster.md, both of which were quoted as fact
# after going wrong. A spell slot is state, and state belongs in a log.
# event
#   anchor     sets the loadout outright, ignoring everything before it
#   memorised  the spell went into a slot after rest and study
#   cast       the slot was spent
# A SPELL STAYS MEMORISED UNTIL IT IS CAST. It is not lost to time — only to
# casting, or to memorising something else after a rest. Player's standing
# instruction, 2026-08-29.
# 1e slots: Frython is a 1st-level magic-user with INT 17 — ONE 1st-level spell
# per day. Yrtone (WIS 16) and Blartho (WIS 15) each get 1 base + 2 bonus = THREE
# 1st-level clerical spells per day.
# The rows below are an ANCHOR, not a replay. Expedition 4's casting history was
# recorded only in prose and the two accounts disagreed — a naive replay left
# Yrtone with no cures while the running state had her holding one. Rather than
# invent a history, the state as played is anchored here and the log runs
# forward from this point.
